sources.quote:
The product description states: Disclosure of AI-generated content The game developer describes the use of AI-generated content in this game as follows: AI was used to create promotional materials for the game's Steam page. Since the "Easy Mode" and "New Game+" update, this is no longer accurate, The new ending is told through text and images, and these images are 100% AI-generated. Here the images (Spoiler Alert this images Spoiler the game end) https://i.imgur.com/GxTdruK.png https://i.imgur.com/uwYfPa1.png https://i.imgur.com/IY1J9HJ.png https://i.imgur.com/5gGUxqv.png
madeaj View Profile View Posts Oct 24 @ 5:25pm Report this post Yeah, I wished they'd left it to the black hole instead of adding AI slop to the end. They could have opened the door, created a shake effect, a boom sound and tossed you back into the messy room. #1
